reuse.why: The change reuses bank lookup, sync processing and response handling, but copies the provider linking workflow, download plumbing and local unlink field reset.

duplication.why: Fintegra adds another copy of the linking lifecycle and transaction downloader, while replacement duplicates the account reset already in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Handlers and downloads follow existing layers, but the Fintegra model belongs in its own provider module rather than simplefin.ts, and link policy would fit the existing link module.

scope.why: All edits directly support the requested linking rules, replacement option and Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared validation keeps all six linking paths aligned, but a validation-named helper now mutates accounts and repeated lifecycle and unlink logic require coordinated maintenance.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All linking handlers use the shared guard and findOrCreateBank; unlinkAccount includes remote connection removal, so it cannot directly serve local-only replacement.

disguised_duplication.where: linkFintegraAccount compresses the existing upgrade/create/payee/sync/notification workflow, and downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing authenticated POST and response projection without sharing them.

abstraction_drift.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked acquires the replaceExistingLink flag and a replacement branch that clears another account's link, expanding a validation helper into a mutating operation; all six linking handlers still call it.
